verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only describes importing/migrating cap tables into Cake from competitors (Carta, Pulley, spreadsheets) via reports like the 'Cap table report, Vesting report and Stakeholder details' — these are export instructions for the *source* platforms, not for exporting live data out of Cake itself. One doc even states Cake's own cap table view requires 'no spreadsheet export needed,' suggesting no dedicated CSV/Excel export feature is emphasized. No first-party or independent evidence shows ops users can export their full cap table and transaction history from Cake to Excel/CSV at any time.
